notes: The encounter arms when 5+ grey nomads exist (or #mg hash forces it). It triggers on the first flame cast at sleep 0. Entry pauses sim flow for 1.5s (90 frames), dims the world, spawns 8 nomads in a ring at distance ~8-10. Player left-clicks to brighten the flame (+0.15), which decays naturally (-0.006/frame). The steady band drifts slowly (target=0.5±0.08*sin). Nomads approach when flame is steady (within ±0.12 of drifting target), recoil if too bright (>target+0.27), drift away if too dim (<target-0.27). Win: all nomads reach distance <2 and committed>0.7 → converts up to 3 grey to devout. Fail flare: flame >target+0.27 → burns up to 2 grey. Fail dim: flame <target-0.27 and 4+ nomads uncommitted → drift_apathy. The first-use line 'You tend the flame, and those who approach will stay only if it neither wavers nor burns.' displays once via pending_teaching on trigger. Overlay draws flame as a circle above player (color/size by brightness), nomads as sprites around the ring (tint/posture by commitment/recoil). Director: verify the drifting target demands active reading, verify nomads kneel in unison on win, verify flare scatters them with arms raised, verify dim causes slow fade-out.
